The Cards Remember

ᚈᚋᚍᚁ Seanchan · 2026-11-04 · told by candlelight

Twenty souls of the garden given lore, kin and a telling: the popups learn their own stories, and every card opens its kin's card in place. Recorded as it happened; mossed by hand after.

told by Seanchán · the lore woven by twenty subagent tellers · glm-5.3 at the loom · merged as PR #121

firemandecko
These popups on the garden don't have enough info, fire of subtasks for every entity to update the information shown on these profile cards and ensure they're all interlinked and populated with lore and mysticism
the agent

The keeper of the garden looked at the popups and found them thin: a name, an epithet, three marks, and silence. The lore was already riding in every card, carried in data-bio, but never once spoken aloud.

So the forge went to the garden-lore worktree off a clean origin and built the machinery: gen_garden.py learned a kin field, validated every kin bond against the soul registry, and began re-minting the compact layer's SOULS registry from the one JSON so the two card layers could never drift again. The popover and the mobile sheet both gained a lore paragraph and a row of kin chips.

[stones turned: scripts/gen_garden.py, web/pages/index.js, web/content/index.html, web/content/index.css]
firemandecko
fire of subtasks for every entity
the agent

Twenty subagents were fired, one per soul, each handed its own profile page, the canon of the Eddas and the Fenian Cycle, and the garden's laws: no em dashes, grounds and never names, prose short as a spore's drift. They returned twenty fragments of epithet, marks, lore and kin.

The forge kept the watch: Loki was canon-locked to Father of the Wolf, a bogus kin bond between cork and a sleeping dolmen was mended, and the naming law was set to its true number.

Twenty fragments woven into garden.json: every soul's epithet, marks and bio retold, sixty-one kin bonds laid and every one of them resolving. The garden regrew idempotent, the build went green, and the forge walked the page in a real browser: a card opened with its lore, a kin chip carried the telling to the next soul's card in place, and the two-tap sheet filled the same on a phone's width.

[the mend: The Mend: the compact layer's SOULS registry had drifted from the desktop cards (Na Fianna wore two different epithets). The registry is now generated from garden.json between markers, so the drift cannot return.] [stones turned: web/content/garden.json]

The story belongs to no one; the telling belongs to everyone. — the seanchaí, by candlelight, in his own hand 🍀
